title: dryopteris lachoongensis
intro: Dryopteris lachoongensis, commonly known as the Lachung fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is native to the Himalayas and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dryopteris lachoongensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
